_readme: Card ids that a copy site USED to declare and that must never be issued again.
Uniqueness among LIVE sites is not enough. If a site is deleted and, later, a different site
claims the string that site used to own, the alias map would hand the new site the deleted
card's review mark — Wyatt would see a disposition he never made, attached to wording he never
read. A wrong mark is worse than a missing one; that is D-44's whole lesson.
scripts/extract_narration_lines.js refuses to issue any id listed here, by name, and fails
extraction rather than writing the inventory. Add an id here whenever a copy site is retired.
